title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Harden RBAC v2 to enforce KMS key region residency and improve audit logging for cross-region KMS access attempts. This PR enforces a policy that prevents resources pinned to a region from using KMS keys outside of that region unless an explicit override is configured and approved. It also plugs audit logging at the enforcement boundary so any denied or overridden KMS access is recorded with context for compliance and incident investigations. Changes include policy enforcement middleware, KMS client region validation, migration guidance, and tests. Checklist: [x] policy enforcer implementation [x] KMS client validation [x] audit/logging hooks [x] integration tests [x] docs and migration notes [ ] rollout gating config (feature flag staged) Rollout plan: feature-flag behind rbac_v2.kms_residency.enabled default=false; staged rollout to dedicated customers and internal canary first week, rollout to hosted API after 2 weeks if no regressions. Related: linked Linear ENG-2141, Security task SEC-98. No customer-facing API changes; config and docs updated.
commits: feat(rbac): add residency policy enforcer middleware and integration points
feat(kms): validate key region against resource residency when provided
chore(audit): add structured audit events for kms residency denials and overrides
test(integration): add rbac-kms residency integration tests and fixtures
docs(security): document migration steps and config flags

Security reviewed the threat model and signoff is recorded under SEC-98.

release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency in RBAC v2 and add structured audit logging for residency denials and overrides. New config flag rbac_v2.kms_residency.enabled (default:false). Migration: cluster operators should audit existing KMS key usage and enable the feature behind a flag; see docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-residency.md for steps.
migration_notes: Operators must run the residency-audit job (scripts/ops/residency_audit.sh) to discover cross-region KMS usage before enabling the feature flag. Overrides require an approver and generate an audit event.
notes_for_backport: Backport to release/2026-02 for Dedicated customers who opt-in; low-risk backport, test plan attached.
security_impact: Medium: prevents accidental cross-region KMS usage; adds audit trails for compliance but introduces new config surface. No secret changes.
